response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net) AS b FROM per_order) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS avg_of_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - bench.b) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_net > bench.b

assumptions.assumption: Net fee rate is computed per fee row as feerate - rebrate; rows where either is NULL give a NULL net rate and are skipped in the averages. Orders whose average net rate is NULL are excluded from the benchmark and the final selection.
Fee records with NULL orderslink form one group, which counts as one 'order' in the benchmark and in the final selection.
